dashboard.title: AW Optimization
dashboard.description: Prioritize evidence-complete token-efficiency candidates without treating measured spend as proof of avoidable waste.

queries.name: optimization-run-observations
queries.intent: Show AW Optimization orchestrator and worker runs so operators can verify activation across AI Credit and ambient-context operations.

queries.name: optimization-retained-outcomes
queries.intent: List retained AW Optimization audits and recommendations without presenting proposed savings or context changes as realized value.

queries.name: optimization-attainment-observations
queries.intent: Query included, matured canonical grader observations for AW Optimization workers while preserving each grader identity and result.

queries.name: token-efficiency-run-cost-candidates
queries.intent: Normalize observed Run-level AI Credit so missing or invalid cost evidence can fail closed.

queries.name: token-efficiency-run-costs
queries.intent: Aggregate valid observed AI Credit for each target workflow Run without synthesizing total tokens.

queries.name: token-efficiency-run-cost-readiness
queries.intent: Require every observed invocation in a Run to have authoritative AIC before that Run can enter optimization comparison or prioritization.

queries.name: token-efficiency-complete-run-costs
queries.intent: Fail closed to exact Runs whose invocation AIC coverage is complete.

queries.name: token-efficiency-run-attempt-evidence
queries.intent: Collapse Run attempts conservatively so reruns become explicit ambiguous evidence instead of expanding or failing the fleet query.

queries.name: token-efficiency-accepted-target-outcomes
queries.intent: Count distinct authoritative accepted safe-output outcomes at exact target workflow Run grain.

queries.name: token-efficiency-run-assignment-outcomes
queries.intent: Attach authoritative accepted target-outcome counts to exact experiment assignments without inferring acceptance from operational-value scores.

queries.name: token-efficiency-mature-grader-candidates
queries.intent: Retain included mature accepted outcomes and declaratively test evaluator and measurement completeness.

queries.name: token-efficiency-mature-graders
queries.intent: Fail closed to mature accepted outcomes with a present evaluator, finite value, and supported direction.

queries.name: token-efficiency-accepted-run-outcomes
queries.intent: Count mature accepted outcomes at Run, experiment, variant, evaluator, and direction grain.

queries.name: token-efficiency-mature-run-values
queries.intent: Fail closed to Runs with at least one accepted, mature operational-value grader observation before deriving portfolio readiness.

queries.name: token-efficiency-assignment-runs
queries.intent: Join included experiment assignments to exact Run cost, reliability, and mature accepted-outcome evidence.

queries.name: token-efficiency-variant-candidates
queries.intent: Aggregate cost, accepted outcomes, reliability, quality, evaluator identity, and sample size per experiment variant.

queries.name: token-efficiency-variant-readiness
queries.intent: Evaluate minimum exact Run and accepted-outcome sample sizes before comparison.

queries.name: token-efficiency-variant-samples
queries.intent: Fail closed to variants with at least two exact Runs and accepted outcomes under one evaluator and direction.

queries.name: token-efficiency-opportunities
queries.intent: Project stable token-efficiency opportunities from canonical audit records.

queries.name: token-efficiency-interventions
queries.intent: Project append-only token-efficiency intervention lifecycle observations from canonical audit records.

queries.name: token-efficiency-applied-intervention-candidates
queries.intent: Collapse complete applied intervention observations to one bounded experiment and control-variant grain.

queries.name: token-efficiency-applied-interventions
queries.intent: Fail closed to applied experiment cohorts with exactly one optimized variant.

queries.name: token-efficiency-supported-run-smells
queries.intent: Retain only audit-produced smell evidence that maps to a closed token-efficiency opportunity kind, then collapse it at exact Run grain.

queries.name: token-efficiency-active-experiment-interventions
queries.intent: Conservatively identify target workflow experiments with any retained active or applied intervention evidence so duplicate optimizer assignments fail closed.

queries.name: token-efficiency-prioritization-run-evidence
queries.intent: Join one matured operational-value opportunity to exact Run smell, lifecycle, invocation-cost, accepted-outcome, quality, and reliability evidence without crossing Run grain.

queries.name: token-efficiency-portfolio-candidate-evaluation
queries.intent: Attach conservative active-intervention state to exact evidence-backed Run candidates and derive fail-closed readiness signals.

queries.name: token-efficiency-portfolio-candidates
queries.intent: Classify exact evidence-backed Run candidates and order them by measured AIC, then repository, workflow, assignment Run, and candidate identity. candidate-readiness is ready only at 21, the sum of every gate score in token-efficiency-portfolio-candidate-evaluation (8 readiness-head + 8 readiness-tail + 4 readiness-run + 1 graded-score); update this threshold alongside candidate-readiness whenever a gate score is added or removed.

queries.name: token-efficiency-optimizer-assignments
queries.intent: Expose only mature, evaluator-backed, non-duplicate exact Run candidates in deterministic measured-AIC priority order for bounded orchestrator dispatch.

queries.name: token-efficiency-portfolio-status-summary
queries.intent: Summarize eligible and incomplete exact Run candidates without treating measured AIC as proof of avoidable waste.

queries.name: token-efficiency-comparison-candidates
queries.intent: Compare complete applied interventions only when control and optimized samples share one evaluator and grading direction.

queries.name: token-efficiency-comparisons
queries.intent: Fail closed to evaluator-compatible control and optimized samples, then expose their declarative progress or regression classification.

queries.name: token-efficiency-progress-summary
queries.intent: Count distinct applied interventions by declaratively derived progress or regression status.

pages.title: AW Optimization
pages.description: Prioritize frozen, evidence-complete token-efficiency candidates while preserving missing evidence, lifecycle state, and measured spend as separate facts.

views.title: Fleet token-efficiency candidate readiness
views.description: Exact Run candidates are eligible only with complete mature cost, accepted-outcome, evaluator, quality, reliability, assignment, and lifecycle evidence. Measured AIC affects ordering only and does not prove avoidable waste.
views.empty-message: No evidence-backed token-efficiency candidates are available; portfolio selection remains unavailable.

views.title: Ranked token-efficiency candidates
views.description: Rows are ordered by eligibility, measured AIC, repository, workflow, assignment Run, and candidate identity. High AIC is a prioritization signal only; incomplete rows remain visible with a fail-closed reason.
views.empty-message: No frozen token-efficiency candidate evidence is available.

views.title: Mature token-efficiency progress and regression
views.description: Applied interventions appear only when both variants have at least two exact Run samples and mature accepted outcomes under the same evaluator and direction. Progress requires lower AI Credit per accepted outcome without reliability or quality regression.
views.empty-message: No evaluator-compatible mature token-efficiency comparison is available.

views.description: Retained snapshots and recommendations expose repository evidence without treating a recommendation as realized savings or context improvement.

actions.intent: Review this optimization output, verify its retained evidence, and identify the safest next action.
actions.label: Review
